direction_of_travel: Four of five pre-election surveys showing Yashar ahead of Likud drove a 12-point downward revision to F5 (0.42→0.30), while the post-UNGA diplomatic collapse and Araghchi's public rejection of direct talks anchored F2 at 0.14, leaving F1 at 0.72 as the only high-probability near-term event on a board that is otherwise tilted toward protracted conflict.
